messages:
sam: quick heads-up — bringing minnow-13b (int4) to dedicated pool for perf eval. seeing OOMs when traffic spikes with max_new_tokens=512, batch=4
ariane: logs? stack traces?
nina: paste from node-7 GPU log: `CUDA OOM at allocate 512MB; kv_slot_alloc failed; memfrag high`
sam: yeah that. interestingly p50 stays fine but p99 rockets. microcushion=0.07 helped a bit (fewer hard OOMs) but still noisy
matt: what are cwnd settings? we've been using default cwnd=32 for that family
sam: cwnd=32. tried cwnd=16 in a quick smoke and p99 latency up a bit but no OOMs at same load
ariane: possible pattern: large max_new + int4 codegen increases transient allocs -> memfrag -> OOM under bursty arrival. maybe try smaller max_new default and softer cwnd backpressure
nina: can we test these variants: (A) max_new_tokens=256, cwnd=32 (B) max_new_tokens=512, cwnd=16 (C) max_new_tokens=256, cwnd=16 + microcushion=0.05
matt: also try slot_compactor aggressiveness up one notch and KV-prefetch disabled for this model — reduces warm allocations
sam: planned canary tomorrow 9am PST with 10% traffic to pool-qa. deploy-bot: canary deploy started for minnow-13b int4 -> pool-qa (config: max_new_tokens=256, cwnd=16, microcushion=0.05) :rocket:
ariane: nice. collect these metrics during canary: p50/p95/p99 latency, OOM count, alloc_peak, kv_eviction_rate, mem_frag_ratio. Also save model traces for any regen failures
nina: i'll add a quick eval run for quality diff vs int8 baseline (200 prompts). if quality delta > 2% we should fallback to int8 automatically in rollout policy
matt: note: batching tweak: limit batch by max_init_tokens too — big input->small output combos still cause spikes. add guard: if input_len > 1024 then soft-limit max_new to 128
sam: agree. i'll update canary config now and kick it off. assigning follow-ups: @nina run quality eval, @ariane set up metric dashboard and alerts, @matt prepare fallback policy PR
sam: thanks team. will post postmortem if things regress.
